parties:
Golam Mohammad ----- Appellant.
Vs.
Sree Sailendra Nath Kanangoe being dead his heirs Sree Biman Behari Kanangoe and others ----- Respondents.
full_judgment: 8. Mr. SC Das is right in stating that the appellant has laid no factual foundations for his assertion that Amalendu Dev was even a proper party in the case. In the first place, the appellant did not take any specific objection that Amalendu Dev was left out. It only transpired from the cross-examination of the pre-emptor that Amalendu Dev purchased a portion of the case plot asserting at the same time that he was not a co-sharer as his name is not in the RS khatian. Secondly, nor was any evidence led that he did not receive any notice of transfer or that he had no knowledge of the proceeding or any other ground. In such circumstances the appellant has failed to prove that Amalendu Dev was even a proper party.
